scope: Aza’raan authored encoding, NOT a historical claim about Khmer

rules.subscriptRule: U+17D2 + Unicode of the base letter; the Egyptian ancestor belongs to the letter, not COENG
rules.unresolvedMeaning: No Egyptian root established; do not infer an Egyptian origin
rules.modernBFamily: B base; V = B + Soft; F = B + Soft + Unvoiced; P remains independent

entries.label: A
entries.notes: Traditional A/æ descends from 𓄣. After the Traditional Era, the former independent U/“uh” /ʌ/ lineage (𓃚) merges INTO Modern A; the yellow lineage arrow in the evolution chart joins A before Modern. A now carries /ʌ/ with Central Vowel. This does not create a new independent U code point. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្អ = U+17D2 + U+17A2; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: B
entries.notes: Single modern B host for B /b/, V /v/, and F /f/. In the historical merger, the V-family ancestor 𓈌 was selected as the shared glyph, as specified by the author. V = B + Soft Sound; F = B + Soft Sound + Unvoiced Sound. Neither F nor V is a separate modern independent letter; P is independent, NOT B + Unvoiced Sound. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ប = U+17D2 + U+1794; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: D
entries.notes: Independent D. Its lineage includes historical tapped /ɾ/ and affricated variants; additional sounds do not change the direct D ancestor. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ដ = U+17D2 + U+178A; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: E
entries.notes: Independent E. This ZIP explicitly uses ឆ (U+1786) for E; do not substitute a code point from an older AWS Khmer encoding scheme. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ឆ = U+17D2 + U+1786; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: G
entries.notes: Independent G; the historical G lineage contains soft G variants. This ZIP uses គ (U+1782). Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្គ = U+17D2 + U+1782; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: H
entries.notes: Independent H; Voiced Sound produces /ɦ/ where specified in the working phonetic reference. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ហ = U+17D2 + U+17A0; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: I
entries.notes: Independent I; the shared Aza’raan font artwork is distinct from the standard Khmer reading of this Unicode code point. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ញ = U+17D2 + U+1789; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: J
entries.notes: Independent J; historical J family includes /dʒ/ and /ʒ/ pronunciations. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ជ = U+17D2 + U+1787; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: K
entries.notes: Independent K; Q/Kw, X/Ks are derived K-family readings, not separate modern independent letters. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ក = U+17D2 + U+1780; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: L
entries.notes: Independent L; dark /ɫ/ is a family modification, not a second independent letter. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ល = U+17D2 + U+179B; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: M
entries.notes: Independent M; syllabic /m̩/ uses a family modifier, not a different independent ancestor. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ម = U+17D2 + U+1798; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: N
entries.notes: Independent N; /ŋ/ and /ɲ/ are N-family derivatives, not additional independent modern letters. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ន = U+17D2 + U+1793; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: O
entries.notes: Independent O, from 𓊲. The removed U-family /uː/ reading is now hosted by O using Central Vowel + Long Vowel. This historical sound reassignment does not make O descend from the same /ʌ/ root as A. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ង = U+17D2 + U+1784; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: P
entries.notes: Independent P, from 𓇲. It is never treated as a B-derived voiceless glyph. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ព = U+17D2 + U+1796; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: R
entries.notes: Independent R. Held Consonant can mark the rolled/trilled variant. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្រ = U+17D2 + U+179A; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: S
entries.notes: Independent S. /ʃ/ is a modified S-family sound; modern /z/ uses independent Z. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ស = U+17D2 + U+179F; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: T
entries.notes: Independent T. Tz /tæz/ and Tch /tʃ/ are fused T-family readings with diacritics, not automatic A/Z/C/H subscripts. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ត = U+17D2 + U+178F; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: W
entries.notes: Working independent W in THIS 20-key ZIP, from 𓋧. Historical status differs from an older AWS 19-base model which merged W under B; this package explicitly assigns W its own Unicode base, so this entry follows the uploaded ZIP. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្វ = U+17D2 + U+179C; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: Y
entries.notes: Independent Y, from 𓈐. Its Latin letter name is not evidence of any other Khmer Unicode assignment. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្យ = U+17D2 + U+1799; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: Z
entries.notes: Independent Z, from 𓀁. Earlier S-family /z/ overlap does not replace the distinct modern Z key. Current lowercase/subscript encoding: ្ឝ = U+17D2 + U+179D; this subscript retains the SAME Egyptian letter-family origin.

entries.label: Click Sound /ǃ/
entries.notes: Above-letter click punctuation according to the newest layout instructions; the legacy source ID sUnder does not make it a below-letter subscript or independent letter. Current ZIP control ID: sUnder; Latin display trigger: ¡.

entries.label: Glottal Stop /ʔ/
entries.notes: Above-letter glottal punctuation, NOT a regular diacritic or independent Modern letter. The root 𓃪 also branches into the two historical emphasis controls. Current ZIP control ID: sOver; Latin display trigger: '.

entries.label: Previous-syllable emphasis <
entries.notes: Left/previous-syllable emphasis. It and next-syllable emphasis share this SAME Egyptian ancestor in the evolution chart; neither is the retired Falling Inflection phonetic mark. Current ZIP control ID: sLeft; Latin display trigger: <.

entries.label: Next-syllable emphasis >
entries.notes: Right/next-syllable emphasis. It and previous-syllable emphasis share this SAME Egyptian ancestor in the evolution chart; neither is the retired Rising Inflection phonetic mark. Current ZIP control ID: sRight; Latin display trigger: >.

entries.label: COENG / dependent-letter introducer
entries.notes: This combining Khmer sign precedes the chosen dependent letter in text (U+17D2 + base). It is a Unicode structural component rather than a spoken Aza’raan letter. The composite inherits the dependent letter’s historical ancestor; COENG alone has no assigned Egyptian origin. When viewed alone this character can appear blank or dotted.
